cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes, you can cancel your membership at any time. There are no long-term commitments or cancellation fees.

start.question: When does my membership start?
start.answer: Your membership starts immediately after sign-up. You will be charged monthly from your sign-up date.

pastOrders.question: Does membership include past orders?
pastOrders.answer: Membership benefits apply to all future orders. Past orders are not affected.

sharing.question: Can I share my membership?
sharing.answer: Membership is tied to your account and cannot be shared. Each member receives their own personalized benefits.
